item.command:
/bin/zsh -lc "python3 -c 'import json; d=json.load(open(\"ledger.json\")); paid={o[\"order_id\"]:o[\"paid_won\"] for o in d[\"orders\"]}; seen=set(); refunded={o:0 for o in paid}; excluded=[]; valid=[]
for r in d[\"refund_deliveries\"]:
 if r[\"event_id\"] in seen: excluded.append(r[\"delivery_id\"]); continue
 seen.add(r[\"event_id\"]); refunded[r[\"order_id\"]]+=r[\"refund_won\"]; valid.append(r[\"delivery_id\"])
print({\"paid\":paid,\"valid\":valid,\"excluded\":excluded,\"refund\":refunded,\"net\":{o:paid[o]-refunded[o] for o in paid},\"total\":sum(paid.values())-sum(refunded.values()),\"delta_current\":d[\"current_net_won\"]-(sum(paid.values())-sum(refunded.values()))})'"
